feed_summary: OpenAI on Wednesday detailed a pipeline that employed an upcoming cyber-focused artificial intelligence (AI) model to validate and patch 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux for $1.2 million in API costs. title: OpenAI AI Pipeline Generates 948 Linux Root Escalation Exploits in 30-Hour Run
